_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `Procedural3dMutation` is a semio-NATIVE vocabulary carried in `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio`, so no oracle is registered and the decision below records what stands in for one.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: No third-party library reads or writes semio's own `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio` envelope, and none is authoritative over `Procedural3dMutation` — a vocabulary over a document that is a COMPOSITION of two unrelated halves, a `fixture` (widget/synapse graph plus camera and layout) and a `generation` (a parameter-set history with a selection), so every one of its fourteen kinds lands in one of exactly TWO top-level fields. That is this subset's own specification, not a fact an external node-graph library could confirm or refute. Confidence comes instead from the committed specification vectors under `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/<kind>/🧪️tests/<fixture>/` — one handcrafted `(before, mutation, diff, outcome, after)` quintet per kind, already unit-tested inside the production crate — replayed end-to-end through the test platform here, plus two metamorphic laws asserted in role: observability (a kind must move the compared projection) and footprint completeness (`before` and `after` may differ on exactly the fields the committed diff declares).
